input.rationale: The Agreement has no indemnification, hold-harmless or defence language anywhere (searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infringe" return nothing; Section 9 Warranties contains only corporate authority reps and the Globix carve-out, and Section 10 General Provisions has no indemnity). HDI builds and hosts the Site and supplies software and technology, so the absence of any HDI IP-infringement indemnity is walk-away territory under the rule and fails even the fallback (no vendor IP indemnity at all). We therefore inserted the preferred HDI indemnity as Section 9(c) — third-party IP claims, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct — with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics, placed in Section 9 so it survives under Section 10.7. We did not add any Company indemnity; a narrow Company indemnity limited to Company-supplied Content would be acceptable if HDI asks for reciprocity.

proposal.summary: Insert HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) as new Section 9(c)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site and Services, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data breaches and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. We placed it in Section 9 so it survives under Section 10.7; if helpful we can accept the usual IP exclusions for Company-supplied Content, modifications and combinations.

ops.text: (c) Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site, the Services or any materials, software or technology provided by HDI (excluding Content provided by the Company) infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, Confidential Information or customer or user data caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall give HDI prompt written notice of any such claim, HDI shall have control of its defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any obligation or admission on the Company shall be entered into without the Company's prior written consent), and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at HDI's expense.
